# Simulator coverage (generated by `python app-sdk/apidoc.py --generate`)

API 2.7. Synchronous inputs and outputs may use the active callback stack; retained SD read/list destinations require app image or tracked app allocations until poll completion.

Host controls: `LAPSIM_HW=wifi,ble,gps,imu,sd,desktop` sets the exact hardware inventory (default `wifi,ble,imu,sd,desktop`; `none` clears it). `LAPSIM_RADIO=none|sim` controls radio presence. API 2.4 adds `rxdelay=N` worker polls, `rxresult=-9` next control failure, and `decode=page,RIC,text` (also flex/aprs/acars/ais/adsb/p25/same); fixtures only reach explicitly attached matching decoders and carry SYNTHETIC provenance. Script steps use `N:command` separated by semicolons: `keydown=W`, `keyup=W`, `keydown=@left`, `buttondown=x,y,button[,buttons]`, `buttonup=x,y,button[,buttons]`, `pointer=x,y,buttons`, `wheel=-3`, `focus=0|1`, `resize=w,h`, `caps=wifi,sd`, `dialogtext=answer`, `dialogpick=0`, `dialogcancel`. `key=` remains a down/up pulse. Mouse buttons are 0=left, 1=middle, 2=right. Save/settings and cached files live under `sdcard/apps_data/<app-id>/`, using the firmware staging, backup, replacement and recovery path. Resize injects an event; renderer geometry remains authoritative.

API 2.4 fixtures: `wifierror=<negative code>`, `httperror=<negative code>`, `httpstatus=200`, `httpbody=text`, `wifidown`, `udpdrop=0|1`, `mdnserror=<negative code>`, `mdnsempty=0|1`, `blesilence=0|1`, `blead=RSSI,HEX`, `gatterror=<negative code>`, `blenotify=HEX`, `bledisconnect`, `micpcm=amplitude`, `micwav=canonical.wav`, `mixpcm=output.s16le`, `audiomute=0|1`, `audiolive=0|1`. Add `speaker,mic` to LAPSIM_HW to fit simulated audio hardware. The host defaults to SIM WLAN, deterministic verified-HTTPS responses and a battery-service peripheral. No external HTTPS connection is made. See [network/audio contracts](NET_AUDIO.md) for bounds and device checks.

API 2.6 Bluetooth peripheral fixtures: `LAPSIM_PERIPHERAL=none|advertiser|gatt|hid` selects build features. `periphbusy=0|1`, `peripherror=<code>`, `periphconnect`, `periphdisconnect`, `periphmtu=185`, `periphbond=0|1`, `periphsubscribe=ID,BITS`, `periphread=ID`, `periphwrite=ID,HEX`, `periphack=0|1`. See [BLE peripheral contracts and RAM](BLE_PERIPHERAL.md).

API 2.5 system fixtures: `desktop=0|1`, `notice=ID,ACTION`, `noticeaction=-1|0|1` (latest app notice), `pick=INDEX`, `pickcancel`; picker rows 0..3 are cancel/up/use-folder/next-page and data begins at 4. Use `sdcard/shared/` for public file fixtures; `caps=none` injects card removal. See [system service contracts](SYSTEM_SERVICES.md).

Real = shared software; faked = synthetic source; limited = host differences; missing = unavailable.

## SDK 2.5 games/assets libraries (no firmware exports)

PNG/mesh fixtures are ordinary host SD files; missing/corrupt/oversized files follow the same loader as the board. `LAPSIM_SCRIPT` supplies held keys, touch/mouse, focus, resize, `mixpcm` and `audiomute` through existing services.

| Helper | Library | Simulator | Reason |
